title: Fabulous and Interesting Sevilla Tour with Luiz
text: Out of all the tours we did on our two week cruise, this was by far our favorite! Luiz provided perspective from all religions Catholic Christian Muslim and Jewish in the most interesting and facinating way. As a great story teller who was masterful at weaving together the Tapestry of Seville -we were so sorry when the tour ended! Highly Recommend this experience and Luiz
author: LeslieKolber
